structured_output.what_is_happening: "Phantom Cat" (PCAT) was launched on the Meteora virtual curve and migrated immediately. It now trades on a PumpSwap pair that is about 15 minutes old. It rose about 330-377% in its first hour on roughly $760k of volume against a $247k market cap, with 1,270 unique buyers and 133 sellers. The token's only social link is an X post by @fadedentry, an account with about 6.4k followers that posts viral narratives alongside contract addresses (an alpha/caller style). The post itself returned HTTP 402 and I could not read it, so I could not identify the underlying Phantom-and-cat event. The price has already fallen about 46% from its ATH of $0.000458. GeckoTerminal shows -43% over the last 5 minutes while DexScreener shows +21%, so the price is swinging hard. At least five other "Phantom Cat" PCAT tokens were launched in the same 6-minute window. This one leads them by liquidity.

narrative.description: The name suggests a Phantom-wallet-related cat meme, maybe a Phantom post or mascot, but I could not verify any such event. Searches found only Phantom's Sui/Monad support shutdown news and nothing about a cat.
narrative.why_spreading: It appears to have been pushed by one narrative/caller X account (@fadedentry) plus trenches bots. Several copycat PCAT tokens launched at once suggest a short-lived trigger on X that I cannot see.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has by far the most liquidity ($47k) and market cap among the same-name clones, and it is the one linked to the @fadedentry post.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least five other 'Phantom Cat' PCAT tokens were created between 22:32 and 22:36 UTC. Two of them (6swV… and 5Cjs…) had $100k-200k of hourly volume and are now at near-zero liquidity, which looks like dead clones. This one was created at 22:38, after several of them.

authenticity.evidence: The only linked social is a caller-style X account that posts contract addresses. GMGN tags 97 bundler wallets (about 10% of top-trader share), and the dev's X account has launched 9 tokens. There are no smart or renowned wallets and no paid DexScreener boosts. The buy count is high relative to page visits (79 GMGN visits).
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read the X post or see how far it spread, and search engines index X poorly.

structural_risks: RugCheck flags 99.99% of LP as unlocked on one market, though GMGN reports an LP burn ratio of 1.0. The two sources conflict.
One unlabelled holder has 80% of supply. It is probably a Meteora pool or vault account, since GMGN puts the top-10 holder rate at 3%, but I could not verify that.
The price is already 46% below its ATH and swinging hard, with conflicting 5-minute readings
Liquidity is $47k against $760k of first-hour volume, so turnover is extreme
The dev's X account has launched 9 tokens

structured_output.counterargument: The volume is real: 1,270 unique buyers against only 133 sellers in 15 minutes, and liquidity has held around $47k. The token has become the clear winner among its clones, and a narrative account is backing it. If the underlying Phantom-cat moment is a real official post, the coin could revisit its $458k ATH and go beyond, which is roughly a 2x from entry.
unknowns: What the @fadedentry post says and how much engagement it has
Whether Phantom or another official account actually posted a cat
Who the 80% top holder account belongs to

source_coverage.notes: A search for the contract address returned nothing relevant. A name/ticker search returned only an old dead PCAT. The X post fetch returned 402. The @fadedentry profile showed up in search results. Time was short, so I did not search Reddit, Telegram or Discord.

structured_output.thesis: This is a hype-driven launch within a cluster of clones, backed by one caller account and bundled wallets. It has already made its main move and fallen 46% from its high, and the narrative is unverified. Doubling from a $247k entry needs a new spike of attention. A fade or chop is more likely, so p_runner is below the pool base rate.
